title: Silky water
summary: Smooth waterfalls and seas with an ND filter.

media.alt: Silky waterfall in a mossy forest

blocks.note: Waterfall: 0.5–2 s. Sea flattened to mist: 15–30 s.

blocks.text: Work out the shutter with your ND filter

steps: Frame and focus **without** the filter, then switch to manual focus.
Meter without the filter and note the shutter speed.
Use the ND calculator to get the new shutter speed and set it.
Use the 2 s timer or a remote so you don't shake the camera.
Check the histogram. Adjust the shutter if needed.

items: Overcast days make it easier: less light and softer contrast.
Over 30 s, switch to Bulb mode and time it with a remote.
Wipe spray off the filter between shots.

steps: Focus without the filter, then switch to **MF** so the camera doesn't hunt in the dark through the ND.
Turn the shutter until the exposure meter reads 0. Note that shutter speed.
Screw on the ND filter. Get the new shutter speed from the ND calculator and set it. M goes up to 30 s.
Longer than 30 s: **Mode dial to B**, then **MENU › Shooting 7 › Bulb timer › Enable** and set the time.
**MENU › Shooting 7 › Drive mode › Self-timer: 2 sec** (or a BR-E1 remote).
Lens IS off on a tripod: the lens switch, or **Shooting 8 › IS mode: Off**.
Shoot, then check the histogram. Turn on **Playback 5 › Highlight alert** to see blown highlights blink.
canon-r10.note: Shooting 5 › Long exp. noise reduction › Auto cleans exposures of 1 s or longer, but the camera then needs as long again to process.
